slate/550.description: App light muted text, darker than 500 for 4.5:1 on glass.

graphite/ink.description: Website light-theme translucent overlays (rgba of this).

base/on-solid.description: Text/icons on a fill that is coloured in every theme (badges, media, the green saved button).

base/shade.description: Black for scrims and shadows; always used with an alpha (color-mix).

base/neutral-tint.description: Mid grey, readable as a tint on light and dark surfaces; used with an alpha.

feedback/ok-bright.description: Bright success green for savings, feed badges and progress fills.

feedback/ok-strong.description: Darker green for success marks and words.

surface/surface-busy.description: Summarise button while a request runs.

surface/surface-paper.description: QR codes need a white quiet zone in every theme.

focus/focus-ring.description: Keyboard focus ring. Sits outside the element (offset), so it is always drawn on the surrounding surface: ≥ 3:1 there in every brand × theme (gate). ADR 0005.

accent/accent-a05.description: Accent at 5%: tints for hover, selection and soft borders. Never as text.

accent/accent-a08.description: Accent at 8%: tints for hover, selection and soft borders. Never as text.

accent/accent-a10.description: Accent at 10%: tints for hover, selection and soft borders. Never as text.

accent/accent-a12.description: Accent at 12%: tints for hover, selection and soft borders. Never as text.

accent/accent-a15.description: Accent at 15%: tints for hover, selection and soft borders. Never as text.

accent/accent-a25.description: Accent at 25%: tints for hover, selection and soft borders. Never as text.

accent/accent-a30.description: Accent at 30%: tints for hover, selection and soft borders. Never as text.

accent/accent.description: Brand action colour: primary buttons, selected states, links on controls, focus ring, progress.

accent/accent-light.description: Second stop of the accent gradient (primary button, nav blob, switch on).

accent/on-accent.description: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, selected pill, active nav item).

accent/accent-soft.description: Light accent tint for selected or hovered rows.

accent/accent-soft-strong.description: Stronger accent tint for pressed or highlighted rows.

accent/accent-subtle.description: Faint accent tint behind accent-coloured text (chips, badges).

accent/accent-selected.description: Accent tint of a selected card or row.

feedback/danger-strong.description: Second stop of the danger gradient (destructive buttons).

feedback/ok.description: Success: saved, synced, signed in (fills and dots; text ≥ 4.5:1 on cards).

feedback/warn.description: Warning fills, borders and dots; as text use caution-fg.

feedback/danger.description: Destructive fills, bars and dots. As text use danger-text (danger is 3.5:1 on dark cards).

feedback/danger-light.description: Light danger tint behind error messages.

feedback/mood-pos.description: Positive mood in charts and dots (graphic, ≥ 3:1).

feedback/mood-neg.description: Negative mood in charts and dots (graphic, ≥ 3:1).

feedback/mood-warn.description: Mixed mood in charts and dots (graphic).

feedback/danger-text.description: Error and delete text, Danger outline buttons: ≥ 4.5:1 on cards, sheets and every sticky note (red 600 was 4.1:1 on AI and Note stickies). ADR 0005.

surface/bg-page.description: Page background of every screen; the base all translucent surfaces are composited over.

surface/glass-base.description: Background of a screen that slides over another (settings, detail); nearly opaque.

surface/glass-card.description: Card surface (article cards, settings rows, input card); translucent over bg-page.

surface/glass-input.description: Field surface: inputs, chips, search fields, icon tiles.

surface/glass-border.description: Edge of glass cards and the input card.

surface/glass-border-strong.description: Stronger glass edge for floating panels and toasts.

surface/surface-bar.description: Background of fixed bars (pane headers, toolbars) above scrolling content.

surface/surface-sheet.description: Bottom sheets and dialogs: opaque so text behind does not show through.

surface/scrim.description: Dims the page behind a sheet or dialog.

surface/surface-floating.description: Floating player, popovers and menus that sit above content.

surface/surface-track.description: Unfilled part of progress bars, sliders and meters.

surface/surface-row.description: Rows inside a sheet or list (send targets, list items).

surface/surface-field.description: Track of segmented controls and filled fields inside sheets.

surface/surface-control.description: Selected segment of a segmented control (raised look).

text/text-primary.description: Body text, titles and icons: the strongest text colour (≥ 14:1 on cards).

text/text-secondary.description: Supporting text: labels, descriptions, inactive controls with text.

text/text-muted.description: Least important readable text: hints, meta lines, timestamps, placeholders (≥ 4.5:1).

outline/outline.description: Default 1px border of cards, fields, bars and dividers. Decorative (about 1.35:1); a field edge that must be found needs outline-strong (ADR 0005).

outline/outline-soft.description: Very subtle border inside glass surfaces.

outline/outline-strong.description: Border that must be seen: focused groups, dashed drop zones, high-contrast theme.

status/tone-read-fg.description: Status “Read” badge text (≥ 5.4:1 on its background).

status/tone-sent-fg.description: Status “Sent” badge text (≥ 5.4:1 on its background).

status/tone-new-fg.description: Status “New” badge text (≥ 5.4:1 on its background).

status/tone-arch-fg.description: Status “Archived” badge text (≥ 5.4:1 on its background).

control/control-grip.description: Drag handle (grip dots) in editable lists.

inverse/surface-inverse.description: Inverse surface (toasts, tooltips): dark in light mode, light in dark mode.

inverse/link-inverse.description: Action or link on surface-inverse (toast Undo).

overlay/overlay-strong.description: Stronger media overlay for text on images.

overlay/overlay.description: Dark overlay on media (video poster, image captions).

data/data-0.description: Chart series 1 of 8: categorical, the same in every brand; pair with labels or symbols (WCAG 1.4.1).

data/data-1.description: Chart series 2 of 8: categorical, the same in every brand; pair with labels or symbols (WCAG 1.4.1).

data/data-2.description: Chart series 3 of 8: categorical, the same in every brand; pair with labels or symbols (WCAG 1.4.1).

data/data-3.description: Chart series 4 of 8: categorical, the same in every brand; pair with labels or symbols (WCAG 1.4.1).

data/data-4.description: Chart series 5 of 8: categorical, the same in every brand; pair with labels or symbols (WCAG 1.4.1).

data/data-5.description: Chart series 6 of 8: categorical, the same in every brand; pair with labels or symbols (WCAG 1.4.1).

data/data-6.description: Chart series 7 of 8: categorical, the same in every brand; pair with labels or symbols (WCAG 1.4.1).

data/data-7.description: Chart series 8 of 8: categorical, the same in every brand; pair with labels or symbols (WCAG 1.4.1).

data/data-other.description: Chart series “other”: neutral grey after the eight categorical colours.

annotation/annotation-user-bg.description: Your highlight: sticky and mark background (yellow).

annotation/annotation-user-bar.description: Your highlight: side bar and mark underline.

annotation/annotation-ai-bg.description: AI highlight: sticky and mark background (blue).

annotation/annotation-ai-bar.description: AI highlight: side bar and mark underline.

annotation/annotation-quote-bg.description: Quote box inside a saved-note card.

surface/bg-page-gradient.description: Postil scheme, light: flat paper, no glow.

surface/glass-inner-glow.description: Postil scheme, dark: no inner highlight.

elevation/shadow-card.description: Postil scheme, dark: cards have no shadow.

player/player-cover-from.description: fixed: decorative placeholder cover, same in every theme

player/player-cover-to.description: fixed: decorative placeholder cover, same in every theme

rsvp/rsvp-pivot.description: Speed reader: the letter the eye anchors on (≥ 3:1 on the reader background).

rsvp/rsvp-context-bg.description: Speed reader: the sentence or paragraph shown around the word.

tint/tint-accent.description: Accent tint behind badges and soft buttons.

tint/tint-neutral.description: Neutral tint for chips and pills.

tint/tint-neutral-cool.description: Cooler neutral tint for alternate rows and chips.

surface/bg-raised.description: Raised band or section above bg.

surface/bg-sunken.description: Sunken band or section below bg.

surface/surface-1-strong.description: Card surface, level 1, more opaque (on busy backgrounds).

surface/surface-2.description: Card surface, level 2 (card inside a card).

surface/sheen-strong.description: White sheen on icons and glossy tiles.

surface/grain-dot.description: Dot colour of the grain texture.

surface/surface-bar.description: Background of fixed bars (pane headers, toolbars) above scrolling content.

surface/surface-bar-solid.description: Opaque header bar (menu open, reduced transparency).

text/text-muted.description: Least important readable text: hints, meta lines, timestamps, placeholders (≥ 4.5:1).

accent/accent.description: Brand action colour: primary buttons, selected states, links on controls, focus ring, progress.

accent/on-accent.description: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, selected pill, active nav item).

feedback/danger.description: Errors and destructive actions on the website.

outline/border-medium.description: Borders of chips, pills and fields.

outline/border-strong.description: Borders that must be seen (focus groups, outlined buttons).

media/media-veil.description: fixed: colours over photos and video, same in every theme

media/media-black.description: fixed: colours over photos and video, same in every theme

media/on-media.description: fixed: colours over photos and video, same in every theme

media/on-media-strong.description: fixed: colours over photos and video, same in every theme

media/on-media-link.description: fixed: colours over photos and video, same in every theme

mark/mark-bg.description: fixed: ghost highlight in feature copy, same in every theme

mark/mark-text.description: fixed: ghost highlight in feature copy, same in every theme
